title: Dream Interpretation [Sea]
text: Dream Interpretation [ Sea ] Placed at your feet means you will inherit a large amount of shoes that are not your size. Walking into one fully garbed means you will drive someone dear to you out of your life. Another burkini ban somewhere and over a hundred degrees, but women strip only their shoes. A few sit in the waves like ocean litter—glossy black bags tossed in and left to soak. I can’t find my sandals. Nothing in this dream is my size. Even the water wraps too tight. Up to my mouth, dark as venom I want to suck into my lungs, lick the cool bottom. I don’t care about the poison because I am thirsty, because I am already sick from the doubt. Someone I lost long ago paddles over, presses an apricot to my mouth. I taste a truce. Its juice drips down their fingers. To sink would be so easy.
